threat_event: Attacker exploits the out-of-date edge router VPN or the EMS web page to gain a foothold in the network hut
threat_source: Cybercriminal or nation-state group targeting carriers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Router firmware 2 years behind with open vendor advisories for its VPN service; EMS web page reachable from the internet until 2026-08-03; no vulnerability tracking
likelihood_basis: EV-011 (router firmware 2 years behind; open advisories); EV-010 (EMS web page reachable from the internet); EV-019 (no scanning in MSP services)
regulatory_driver: CSF PR.PS-02 and ID.RA-01 benchmark; supports C-COMMUNICATIONS-R01 (64.2010(a))
existing_controls: Router inbound filters; EMS exposure removed 2026-08-03
treatment_plan: Upgrade router firmware in the 2026-09-20 maintenance window; upgrade OLT firmware; monthly review of vendor and CISA advisories; quarterly external scan

threat_event: Intruder uses stolen or shared credentials to export call detail records from the hosted voice platform (P08 scenario)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA on the voice platform admin portal; shared "support" login; every login can export 18 months of CDRs; credentials stored in a text file on the hut server
likelihood_basis: EV-006 (no MFA; shared login; export open to every login); EV-049 (password file on the hut server)
existing_controls: Portal sign-in with password; provider fraud alerts on international calling
treatment_plan: Enable MFA and named logins on the voice platform; limit CDR export to 2 roles; remove the shared login; password manager replaces the text file; monthly export log review

threat_event: Pretexter obtains a customer's call detail by phone or at the counter
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Call detail released when the representative recognizes the caller or after name and service address; PIN optional and set on about 30% of voice accounts; no CPNI training
likelihood_basis: EV-024 (caller verified by name and service address); EV-023 (PIN on about 30% of voice accounts); EV-030 (no CPNI training records); EV-054 (7 of 10 releases without a PIN)
existing_controls: Representatives know many customers personally
treatment_plan: Required PIN for phone release of call detail (otherwise send to the address of record or call back the number of record); photo ID at the counter; CPNI training with signed record

threat_event: Fraudster takes over a customer's online account through the portal password reset or the AI assistant guest verification and views call detail
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Reset uses account number and last name (printed on every bill); guest verification used account number and service address (off since 2026-08-14); no change notices
likelihood_basis: EV-004 (reset by account number and last name; no change notices); EV-025 (guest verification on); EV-053 (reset test)
existing_controls: Portal lockout after 5 failures
treatment_plan: One-time-code reset to the telephone number or email of record; change notices to the number or address of record; guest verification stays off

threat_event: Former employee uses a shared network password to reach the OLTs or EMS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One shared administrator login on OLTs and EMS; not changed when a Field Technician left in March 2026 (changed 2026-07-23); no termination checklist
likelihood_basis: EV-009 (one shared login); EV-001 (March 2026 termination); EV-049 (departed technician still knew the password)
existing_controls: Hut fence and alarm; VPN needed for remote access
treatment_plan: Named accounts through RADIUS or TACACS+ authentication; last-day checklist that includes shared secrets; monthly account review

threat_event: Intruder in the hut uses the stored BSS API key to read every customer record, including driver license numbers (Florida breach of about 1,050 people)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: API key with full administrator rights stored in plain text on the hut server; unencrypted server disks
likelihood_basis: EV-003 (API key with full administrator rights); EV-049 (key stored on the hut server); EV-015 (disks not encrypted); EV-023 (driver license numbers on about 1,050 accounts)
existing_controls: BSS logs API calls
treatment_plan: Replace with a provisioning-only key stored in protected configuration; stop collecting driver license numbers and purge stored ones after the identity check; BSS bulk-read alert

threat_event: Network configurations cannot be restored after a hut fire, flood, theft, or ransomware on the hut server
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Configuration backups only on the hut server; reachable with the shared login; never restore-tested
likelihood_basis: EV-014 (backups only on the hut server; no restores); EV-048 (consultant holds an old router configuration by email)
existing_controls: Nightly configuration backups on the hut server; consultant has an old router configuration by email
treatment_plan: Encrypted off-site copy through the cloud backup; restore test to the spare chassis; twice-yearly tests

threat_event: A CPNI breach is reported late to the USSS and FBI, or customers are told before the law enforcement hold ends
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No CPNI breach procedure; no account on the FCC reporting facility; staff unaware of the 7-business-day rule
likelihood_basis: EV-028 (no CPNI breach procedure); EV-052 (no one knew the reporting facility or the notice hold)
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: POL-03 and the P08 runbook; reporting facility access tested; tabletop exercise

threat_event: FCC enforcement because the annual CPNI certification statement is inaccurate
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Template statement says passwords protect call detail; officer signed without supporting evidence
likelihood_basis: EV-031 (template certification statement); EV-054 (call detail released without a PIN)
existing_controls: Certification filed on time every year
treatment_plan: Evidence-based statement for the filing due 2027-03-01, reviewed by the regulatory consultant; counsel advises on correcting the 2026 statement

threat_event: An intrusion goes unnoticed and the evidence is lost before anyone looks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security monitoring; device logs roll over in about 14 days; nobody reviews BSS or voice platform logs
likelihood_basis: EV-016 (availability alerts only); EV-012 (device logs about 14 days); EV-005 (no BSS report runs)
existing_controls: Availability monitoring only
treatment_plan: Login and configuration-change alerts; network logs kept 1 year; monthly log review; voice platform export alerts

threat_event: A cut of the single middle-mile circuit stops all broadband and voice service
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One leased 10 Gbps circuit with no diverse path; office internet rides on the same circuit
likelihood_basis: EV-035 (one middle-mile circuit; 4-hour repair target); EV-041 (2025 middle-mile cut of 2 hours 40 minutes)
existing_controls: Provider 4-hour repair target
treatment_plan: Quotes for a physically diverse second circuit; 2027 budget decision; customer 911 messaging and business number forwarding in the contingency plan

threat_event: A qualifying outage is not reported to the FCC on time, or the county 911 center is not told
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Thresholds known only to the Network Operations Lead; no 911 outage contacts on file; a 2025 middle-mile cut of 2 hours 40 minutes was not assessed against the OC3-minute threshold
likelihood_basis: EV-041 (no 911 outage contact; 2025 outage not assessed); EV-048 (thresholds known to the Network Operations Lead only)
existing_controls: NORS login exists (set up 2018)
treatment_plan: Written outage checklist with the thresholds; collect and confirm 911 outage contacts every year; train the Field Technicians on call

threat_event: Hurricane damages the hut or the fiber plant, causing a multi-day outage, and DIRS reports are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No contingency plan; no DIRS procedure; fuel for about 72 hours
likelihood_basis: EV-028 (no contingency plan or DIRS procedure); EV-040 (fuel for about 72 hours); EV-048 (hurricane preparation)
existing_controls: Propane standby generator; spare parts in the warehouse
treatment_plan: Contingency plan with a hurricane checklist, fuel contract, DIRS steps, and customer messaging

threat_event: Ransomware delivered by phishing encrypts office computers and the shared drive
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No phishing training; antivirus alerts in business hours only
likelihood_basis: EV-030 (no phishing training); EV-018 (antivirus alerts in business hours)
existing_controls: MSP patching and antivirus; suite MFA; nightly suite backup
treatment_plan: Annual training and quarterly phishing simulations; after-hours alerting by the MSP

threat_event: Business email compromise leads to a fraudulent payment to a fake vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor bank changes accepted by email; no call-back rule
likelihood_basis: EV-048 (vendor bank changes accepted by email)
existing_controls: Suite MFA
treatment_plan: Call-back to a known number before any bank change; training

threat_event: Law enforcement cannot reach the company about an intercept, or a compromise of intercept information is not reported
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2017 SSI filing lists a former technician as the 24x7 contact; no compromise reporting step; amendments never filed
likelihood_basis: EV-032 (2017 filing names a technician no longer employed); EV-001 (payroll roster)
existing_controls: TTP contract; one order handled correctly in 2022
treatment_plan: Rewrite and refile the SSI policies through CEFS; add compromise reporting to POL-03 and P08

threat_event: Hosted voice platform outage or compromise stops voice service and 911 calling for all customers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single wholesale platform; no evidence of the provider's recovery or security reviewed
likelihood_basis: EV-034 (voice platform contract; no security or recovery evidence)
existing_controls: Contract states 99.99% availability
treatment_plan: Request the provider's SOC report or questionnaire; outage notice terms; customer 911 messaging

threat_event: AI assistant shows CPNI to someone who is not the account holder
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Guest verification with account number and service address (on by vendor default until 2026-08-14); prompt injection not tested by the vendor for this tenant
likelihood_basis: EV-025 (guest verification on by vendor default); EV-053 (assistant test)
existing_controls: Signed-in sessions limited to the customer's own account by the BSS
treatment_plan: Guest verification stays off; account data only after portal sign-in; vendor prompt-injection test results (see P10)

threat_event: AI assistant uses call detail to recommend broadband upgrades without CPNI approval, or gives wrong bill answers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: "Personalized offers" setting on by default; no accuracy sampling
likelihood_basis: EV-025 (personalized offers on by vendor default); EV-053 (assistant test)
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Personalized offers off; monthly transcript sample (see P10)

threat_event: Compromise of the network engineering consultant's computer or VPN login gives attackers administrator access to the network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared VPN login with no MFA; consultant's own security unknown; full administrator rights
likelihood_basis: EV-010 (shared consultant VPN login, password only); EV-035 (retainer letter only)
existing_controls: Retainer letter only
treatment_plan: Named consultant login with MFA; access enabled only for scheduled work; security and notice terms in a new consultant agreement

threat_event: Lost or stolen laptop or tablet exposes cached data or saved network notes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Devices travel with technicians
likelihood_basis: EV-018 (laptops and tablets encrypted; remote wipe); EV-017 (tablet passcode)
existing_controls: Laptops encrypted; tablets encrypted with passcode; MSP can wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted: devices are encrypted; residual risk Low once shared network passwords move to the password manager (R-002)

threat_event: Vandalism or theft at the network hut damages equipment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote rural lot
likelihood_basis: EV-049 (fenced lot, locked gate, alarmed door); EV-040 (hut key list)
existing_controls: Fenced lot, locked gate, keyed and alarmed door
treatment_plan: Accepted: existing physical controls are proportionate; spares in the warehouse

threat_event: A vendor that holds customer data (BSS, answering service) has a breach and the company learns late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident notice terms except the TTP; vendor reviews not done
likelihood_basis: EV-035 (no incident notice terms); EV-036 (BSS SOC 2 report)
existing_controls: BSS vendor SOC 2 report on file
treatment_plan: Incident notice terms (24 hours) and CPNI confidentiality at renewal; annual vendor review

threat_event: Attacker uses the default SNMP read-write community string to change the aggregation switch configuration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor default read-write string active (found in P07 testing); SNMP version 2c in clear text
likelihood_basis: EV-IA-5 (default SNMP string found in P07 testing)
existing_controls: Reachable only from the hut management segment
treatment_plan: Remove read-write SNMP; change community strings; move to SNMP version 3 at the OLT upgrade
